categories.title: Organization-wide AI risk policies, processes, procedures and practices are in place, transparent and effective

Organisational culture considers and communicates AI risk

notes: No official NIST machine-readable AI RMF/Playbook data was found: guessed paths in usnistgov/oscal-content returned 404 and api.github.com directory listing is unavailable; nist.gov/airc.nist.gov blocked (CONNECT 403 / ENOTFOUND). Subcategory lists deliberately left EMPTY because they were not obtained from an official source. GOVERN category titles are paraphrases of secondary summaries; MAP/MEASURE/MANAGE titles are null because no reliable wording was seen. The seven trustworthiness characteristics were seen in a search snippet attributed to airc.nist.gov plus several secondary summaries. AI RMF is voluntary guidance, not law or certification; secondary sources report a revision in progress (unconfirmed).
